title: Draw a maze and time a friend
description: Draw a maze with one path and time someone from the start to the end.
oneStarDescription: Draw a maze you can solve.
twoStarDescription: Time a person from start to end without pointing unless they ask.
threeStarDescription: After they finish or stop, show one wrong turn.

title: Redraw a pattern from memory
description: Look at a short pattern, cover it, and redraw it.
oneStarDescription: Look at a pattern of up to six marks.
twoStarDescription: Cover it and redraw it. Leave the result where a watcher can see it.
threeStarDescription: Uncover and mark what differed.

title: Draw a viewfinder
description: Cut a small rectangle and use it to choose a view before you draw or photograph.
oneStarDescription: Cut a small window in card.
twoStarDescription: Hold it up and name what is inside.
threeStarDescription: Draw or photograph that view and say what you left out.

title: Draw parallel lines with a guide
description: Draw two lines that stay the same distance apart.
oneStarDescription: Draw one straight line with a guide.
twoStarDescription: Draw a second line and measure the gap at both ends.
threeStarDescription: Say whether the lines would meet if extended, from the two measures.

title: Draw a shape without lifting
description: Draw a simple house or envelope outline and say whether the pencil left the page.
oneStarDescription: Say which outline you will draw.
twoStarDescription: Draw it in one trip if you can.
threeStarDescription: Say whether the pencil lifted, and where.

title: Drop a paper loop glider
description: Make a glider with a paper loop, launch it, and say whether it flew or dove.
oneStarDescription: Fix one paper loop to a straw or a strip.
twoStarDescription: Give it one gentle launch.
threeStarDescription: Say whether it flew, dove, or turned.

title: Drop a paper helicopter
description: Make a paper helicopter, drop it, and say whether it spun.
oneStarDescription: Cut the strip and fold the blades opposite ways.
twoStarDescription: Drop it from a raised hand.
threeStarDescription: Say whether it spun, and what you would change if it did not.

title: Drum a pattern on your chest
description: Tap a three-hit pattern on your chest and repeat it once the same way.
oneStarDescription: Tap three hits you can remember.
twoStarDescription: Repeat it once without adding a hit.
threeStarDescription: Tap the same pattern on the table and say what changed.

title: Erase a pencil line without a tear
description: Erase a pencil line and show the paper still whole.
oneStarDescription: Draw one pencil line on scrap.
twoStarDescription: Erase it until the line is gone or a ghost remains.
threeStarDescription: Show that the paper did not tear.

title: Explain a trick after you show it
description: Show one small trick you can do, then explain the method to the person who watched.
oneStarDescription: Do the trick once. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can show it.
twoStarDescription: Explain the method in a few sentences.
threeStarDescription: Let them try the method, or show the one move they missed.

title: Fade a hummed note
description: Hum a note and make it quieter until it disappears.
oneStarDescription: Hum one steady note before you start to make it quieter.
twoStarDescription: Reduce the sound without changing to speech.
threeStarDescription: Stop on silence and stay quiet for a moment.

title: Fill a small nonogram
description: Fill a small picture grid from the numbers, and check the row clues.
oneStarDescription: Complete one row from its clue.
twoStarDescription: Complete the small grid.
threeStarDescription: Check one column against its clue and fix it if needed.

title: Fill the frame with a texture
description: Take a photo where a texture fills the frame, with no horizon.
oneStarDescription: Point to the texture before you shoot.
twoStarDescription: Take the photo so the texture goes to the edges.
threeStarDescription: Look at the photo and say whether an edge of the object shows.

title: Film your hands so the move shows
description: Film your hands doing one move so a viewer can see the move.
oneStarDescription: Film so both hands stay in view.
twoStarDescription: Do one move once. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can do it on camera.
threeStarDescription: Watch the clip and say whether the move is visible.

title: Find a heavier ball
description: Use a balance twice at most to find which of three balls is heavier, if you know one is.
oneStarDescription: Weigh two balls against each other.
twoStarDescription: Say which is heavier from that weighing, or weigh the third if they balanced.
threeStarDescription: Check on the balance and say whether you were right.

title: Find a seat from a row number
description: Find a seat from a row and a letter in a room, a vehicle, or a drawing.
oneStarDescription: Read the row and the letter.
twoStarDescription: Stand at that seat or point to it on a plan.
threeStarDescription: Say who or what is on one side, from the labels.

title: Find the center with diagonals
description: Draw both diagonals of a rectangle and mark where they cross.
oneStarDescription: Draw one corner-to-corner line.
twoStarDescription: Draw the second diagonal.
threeStarDescription: Mark the crossing and check it is inside the rectangle.

title: Find the full glass by sound
description: Tap glasses with different amounts of water and say which sounds lower.
oneStarDescription: Fill them to two different levels.
twoStarDescription: Tap each and say which sounds lower.
threeStarDescription: Look at the levels and say whether your ear matched the fuller glass.

title: Find a group of two black keys
description: Find a pair of black keys on a keyboard and name the white key between them.
oneStarDescription: Point to two black keys that sit together.
twoStarDescription: Point to the white key between them.
threeStarDescription: Find a second pair and show it is the same grouping.

title: Finger-knit a cord
description: Finger-knit a short cord and pull it so the stitches stay.
oneStarDescription: Make the first stitches on your fingers.
twoStarDescription: Knit a length you can hold up.
threeStarDescription: Pull the working yarn and show the cord does not unravel at the tied end.

title: Finger-spell your name
description: Finger-spell your name from a chart, slowly enough to be followed.
oneStarDescription: Form each letter from the chart.
twoStarDescription: Pause between letters. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can separate letters.
threeStarDescription: Ask someone with the chart to say the name back.

title: Finish a tangram outline
description: Fill a tangram outline with the pieces, without looking at a solution picture.
oneStarDescription: Lay all seven pieces out so each one is visible before you start.
twoStarDescription: Cover the outline without overlaps you ignore.
threeStarDescription: If you stop, name one piece that does not fit yet.

title: Flex a hexaflexagon
description: Fold a simple flexagon and flex it so a new face shows.
oneStarDescription: Fold the strip into the flexagon.
twoStarDescription: Flex it until another face is on top.
threeStarDescription: Point to the face that was hidden.

title: Flick a coin along a table
description: Flick a coin so it slides and stops inside a target you marked.
oneStarDescription: Mark a small area on the table.
twoStarDescription: Slide the coin with one flick.
threeStarDescription: Say whether it stopped inside the mark.

title: Flip a card cleanly
description: Flip one card from face down to face up without sending it off the table.
oneStarDescription: Place one card face down.
twoStarDescription: Flip it face up on the table.
threeStarDescription: Show it stayed on the table.

title: Float a paperclip
description: Float a dry paperclip on water and say what happens when you touch the surface.
oneStarDescription: Lay the clip on the water so it stays up.
twoStarDescription: Touch the water and say whether the clip sank.
threeStarDescription: Dry the clip and try again, or say the water is now disturbed.

title: Float a stroked needle
description: Stroke a needle with a magnet, float it on a cork, and see it settle on a north-south line you check with a compass or a map.
oneStarDescription: Stroke one way with a magnet.
twoStarDescription: Set it on a cork in a still bowl.
threeStarDescription: Compare the settled line with a compass or a known north, and say if you had no check.

title: Float and sink the same egg
description: Show one egg sinking in fresh water and floating in salty water.
oneStarDescription: Put the egg in fresh water and show it sinks.
twoStarDescription: Add salt until the same egg floats.
threeStarDescription: Say you changed the water, not the egg.

title: Fold a boat and float it
description: Fold a paper boat and show whether it floats for a moment.
oneStarDescription: Fold a boat that sits open.
twoStarDescription: Set it on water and say if it floats.
threeStarDescription: If it sinks, point to where the water entered.

title: Fold a cloth into a triangle
description: Fold a square cloth into a triangle that stays folded.
oneStarDescription: Fold the square in half into a triangle.
twoStarDescription: Fold it into a smaller triangle.
threeStarDescription: Show the edges that line up, or the one that does not.

title: Fold a paper cup that holds a bean
description: Fold a paper cup and put a dry bean in it without the bean falling through.
oneStarDescription: Fold a cup that stands. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can fold the cup.
twoStarDescription: Put one dry bean inside.
threeStarDescription: Lift the cup and show the bean stayed in.

title: Fold a fan that opens
description: Fold a paper fan and open it with one hand.
oneStarDescription: Make pleats that stack. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can pleat.
twoStarDescription: Open the fan in one motion.
threeStarDescription: Close it back into the stack.

title: Fold a fitted sheet
description: Fold a fitted sheet into a rectangle you can stack, and say where a corner is tucked.
oneStarDescription: Tuck one elastic corner into another.
twoStarDescription: Fold it into a rectangle.
threeStarDescription: Point to the tucked corner in the finished fold.

title: Fold a fortune teller and use it
description: Fold a paper fortune teller, write four outcomes, and use it once as a game.
oneStarDescription: Fold the teller so it opens both ways.
twoStarDescription: Write four harmless outcomes.
threeStarDescription: Run it once with a person and read the outcome you land on.

title: Fold a paper hat that stays
description: Fold a paper hat and wear it long enough to turn your head.
oneStarDescription: Fold a hat from newspaper or a large sheet.
twoStarDescription: Put it on and turn your head.
threeStarDescription: If it slips, refold one edge and try again.

title: Fold a letter into itself
description: Fold a written sheet so the writing is inside and the sheet stays closed.
oneStarDescription: Write one line you will hide.
twoStarDescription: Fold it so the line is inside and the sheet holds.
threeStarDescription: Open it, show the line, and close it again.

title: Fold a map to one panel
description: Fold a paper map so the part you need stays visible and the rest stays folded.
oneStarDescription: Point to the part you need.
twoStarDescription: Fold so that part is on top.
threeStarDescription: Open it and fold back to the same panel.

title: Fold a napkin so it stands
description: Fold a napkin into a shape that stands on a table.
oneStarDescription: Fold one standing shape.
twoStarDescription: Stand it and take your hands away.
threeStarDescription: Unfold it so it can still be used as a napkin.

title: Fold a right angle
description: Fold a paper right angle and test it against a corner you trust.
oneStarDescription: Fold a straight edge onto itself to make a right angle.
twoStarDescription: Hold it against a known square corner.
threeStarDescription: Say whether it matched or where it gaped.

title: Fold a towel that stacks
description: Fold a towel into a rectangle and stack a second fold on it so the edges match.
oneStarDescription: Fold one towel into a rectangle.
twoStarDescription: Fold a second the same way and stack it.
threeStarDescription: Say whether the edges match.
